description: Five men in dark robes, some with fur collars and some in monk-like hoods, sing around a large open book of music on a dark wooden lectern. Two tall lit candles stand on brass holders beside the book, and a third candle is behind it. The setting is a stone interior with pointed Gothic arches, ribbed vaulting and tall columns fading into shadow. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text or frame.
